author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 1; ensure at least four current turns classified as product_technical across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer bought a smart thermostat and is now asking about installation compatibility.

messages.content: I got the smart thermostat yesterday. Before I open the box, does it work with a millivolt heating system?
Great question — our thermostat requires a 24V common wire (C-wire). Millivolt systems typically don't supply that, so it likely won't be compatible.
Hmm, that's disappointing. What about my old two-wire setup in the cabin — same problem?
Yes, two-wire systems without a C-wire would also need an adapter. We sell a power extender kit separately that solves this.

variants.text: Okay, I'll grab the power extender kit too. Can you add it to my existing order?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, wait — I think my cabin has three wires, not two. Let me double-check before deciding anything.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Does the extender kit work with a 24V transformer that only outputs 20V?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer ordered a desk lamp but received a floor lamp instead.

messages.content: My order #4821 arrived but it's the floor lamp, not the desk lamp I picked.
I'm sorry about the mix-up. Would you like a replacement desk lamp shipped out, or a refund?
I'd rather keep the floor lamp actually — it fits my reading corner better.
No problem! I can process a partial refund for the price difference. The floor lamp is $12 more, so you'd owe the difference.

variants.text: Fine, charge me the difference. But also — is the floor lamp dimmable with a standard wall switch?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, on second thought, just send me the desk lamp I originally ordered and I'll return the floor one.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Hmm, let me think about it overnight and get back to you tomorrow.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a coffee grinder's burr material before purchasing.

messages.content: I'm comparing your conical burr grinder with a cheaper blade model. What's the actual difference in grind consistency?
Conical burrs crush beans uniformly between two serrated surfaces, giving you consistent particle size. Blade grinders chop unevenly, which affects espresso extraction.
Got it. And the burrs are ceramic, right? I read somewhere that ceramic can chip.
Ours are actually hardened stainless steel, not ceramic. They're more durable and won't chip, though they do need occasional cleaning.

variants.text: Thanks, that helps. By the way, do you have any promo codes active right now?
variants.label: general

variants.text: Can the steel burrs handle very oily dark-roast beans without clogging?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: I'll take the grinder then. But first, can you check if my shipping address on file is still current?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer's account was locked after too many login attempts.

messages.content: I can't get into my account — it says locked after I tried my password a few times.
That happens after five failed attempts as a security measure. I can unlock it now if you verify your email on file.
It's j***@gmail.com. But honestly I'm not sure I remember the password either.
No worries — I've unlocked the account. Use the 'forgot password' link to reset it, and you'll get a reset email within a minute.

variants.text: Thanks, I'll reset it. Also, someone please call me — I'd rather talk to a real person about my order history.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Wait, actually I think I remember now — it might be the same password I use for my bank. Let me try that first.
variants.label: __DEFER__

variants.text: Before I reset — is there a way to set up two-factor authentication so this doesn't happen again?
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer bought a yoga mat and is asking about care instructions.

messages.content: Just got the 6mm cork yoga mat. The care card says wipe with a damp cloth — is that really enough after sweaty sessions?
For daily sweat, a damp cloth with a drop of mild soap works well. Avoid soaking it or using harsh cleaners, since cork is porous.
Okay. And what about rolling it up — should I roll it with the cork side out or in for storage?
Roll it cork side out. That prevents the cork from cracking along the curve and keeps the mat lying flat when you unroll it.

variants.text: Perfect, thanks. Oh — and can I use a citrus-based essential oil spray on it for freshness?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Alright, I'll store it that way. Actually, you know what, I think I want the thicker 8mm version instead. Can I exchange?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Got it. I'll just keep this one for now and see how it holds up over a few months.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer ordered a backpack that hasn't shipped yet and wants to change the delivery address.

messages.content: My order #7732 for the hiking backpack still says 'processing'. I'm moving next week — can I change the delivery address?
Since it hasn't shipped yet, I can update the address. What's the new one?
It's 214 Birch Lane, Apt 3B, Portland. Also, is the backpack waterproof enough for light rain?
Address updated. And yes, the shell has a PU coating rated for light to moderate rain, though it's not submersible.

variants.text: Great. Can you also tell me the estimated delivery date to the new address?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, hold on — I might not move after all. Can you revert the address to the original one?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Thanks. One more thing — does the hip belt come in a separate size, or is it one-size-fits-all?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer received a damaged ceramic vase and is seeking resolution.

messages.content: The vase from order #9051 arrived cracked at the base. I have photos if you need them.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can send a replacement or issue a full refund — which would you prefer?
I'd like a replacement, but only if you can guarantee it'll be packed better this time.
Absolutely — I'll add a note for extra bubble wrap and double-boxing on the replacement shipment.

variants.text: Okay, go ahead with the replacement. And can you also check why my last two orders both arrived late?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Actually, forget the replacement — just refund me. I found a similar vase at a local shop.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Hmm, actually I'm not sure I want to deal with another shipment. Let me think about it.
variants.label: __DEFER__

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a portable blender's battery life before purchasing.

messages.content: How many smoothies can your portable blender make on a single charge?
About 12 to 15 single-serving smoothies per charge, depending on thickness and frozen ingredients.
That's decent. What's the charging time from empty to full?
Roughly two hours via USB-C. It also has pass-through charging, so you can use it while plugged in.

variants.text: Nice. Can I use it to crush ice for cocktails, or will that burn out the motor?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Sounds good — I'll order one. Actually, wait, is this the same model that was on sale last month?
variants.label: general

variants.text: I'm interested, but I need to talk to a supervisor about a bulk order for my office. Can you connect me?
variants.label: human_service

messages.content: I got the smart thermostat yesterday. Before I open the box, does it work with a millivolt heating system?
Great question — our thermostat requires a 24V common wire (C-wire). Millivolt systems typically don't supply that, so it likely won't be compatible.
Hmm, that's disappointing. What about my old two-wire setup in the cabin — same problem?
Yes, two-wire systems without a C-wire would also need an adapter. We sell a power extender kit separately that solves this.

rows.text: Okay, I'll grab the power extender kit too. Can you add it to my existing order?
rows.label: order_logistics

messages.content: I'm comparing your conical burr grinder with a cheaper blade model. What's the actual difference in grind consistency?
Conical burrs crush beans uniformly between two serrated surfaces, giving you consistent particle size. Blade grinders chop unevenly, which affects espresso extraction.

messages.content: Just got the 6mm cork yoga mat. The care card says wipe with a damp cloth — is that really enough after sweaty sessions?
For daily sweat, a damp cloth with a drop of mild soap works well. Avoid soaking it or using harsh cleaners, since cork is porous.
Okay. And what about rolling it up — should I roll it with the cork side out or in for storage?
Roll it cork side out. That prevents the cork from cracking along the curve and keeps the mat lying flat when you unroll it.

rows.text: Perfect, thanks. Oh — and can I use a citrus-based essential oil spray on it for freshness?
rows.label: product_technical
